text:
alen: hit a weird install loop onboarding the python sample. local `poetry install` is fine but CI `pip install -r requirements.txt` keeps retrying indexes and ends up with an older wheel (typing-extensions mismatch).
zoe: can you paste the pip snippet?
alen: sure: ```Collecting typing-extensions==4.7.1
  Retrying (retrying with the next mirror) from https://internal-pypi/simple/
  Downloading typing_extensions-4.5.0-py3-none-any.whl (27 kB)
Installing collected packages: typing-extensions
Successfully installed typing-extensions-4.5.0``` so pip asked for 4.7.1 but installed 4.5.0 from our mirror.
pat: that smells like our mirror proxy returning a cached bucket with incorrect filename/metadata. could also be old pip resolver behaviour with environment markers. what pip version is CI using?
alen: CI uses the distro python image with pip 22.0.4. Export was done with `poetry export -f requirements.txt --without-hashes -o requirements.txt` and the file has `typing-extensions==4.7.1`.
zoe: older pip can mishandle manylinux/marker logic. first try: upgrade pip in CI to >=23.1. second: add an explicit pre-install of the critical dep to force correct wheel: `python -m pip install --upgrade pip setuptools wheel` then `pip install --no-deps --index-url https://pypi.org/simple typing-extensions==4.7.1 --no-cache-dir` before the main `pip install -r requirements.txt`.
pat: FYI our SDK's optional deps include `httpx[http2]` which pulls some binary deps; our internal index had a corrupt macos wheel earlier and pip fell back to an older universal wheel. that also caused some subtle import-time typing/Protocol errors. opened infra ticket.
infra-bot: INFRA-1002 opened: mirror returned mismatched file for typing-extensions; planned purge + re-mirror.
ci-bot: build #8123 failed on step "pip install -r requirements.txt"  https://ci.internal/8123
alen: temporary CI patch I used: ```python -m pip install --upgrade pip setuptools wheel
pip install --no-deps --index-url https://pypi.org/simple typing-extensions==4.7.1 --no-cache-dir
pip install -r requirements.txt``` this made the job green.
zoe: nice. long-term: two things: 1) sample-app CI should run a post-install assert `python -c "import typing_extensions as te; print(te.__version__)"` to fail fast if mirror returns wrong package, 2) recommend in onboarding docs that teams exporting from poetry either use `--with-hashes` or maintain a pinned constraints.txt generated by `pip-compile` for CI installs.
pat: sdk-python should add a packaging smoke test that builds the wheel in a clean venv and imports typing-only modules (py.typed/_stubs) to catch missing files. raised https://github.com/redwood/sdk-python/issues/347 with repro.
alen: created PR in sample-app that adds the pre-install and the verify step; CI green on branch. will close when infra confirms mirror purge. :white_check_mark:
